Aur tumhein kya maaloom ke woh kaisi khadkhadaane waali hai
Jis din log bikhre hue patangon ki maanind ho jaayenge
Aur pahaad dhunki hui rooi ki tarah udne lagenge
To us din jis ki nekiyon ka palla bhaari hoga
Aur jis ka palla halka hoga
